defect.class: ATTRIBUTION AND PUBLICATION STATUS NOT ENTAILED BY THE PACKET
defect.detail: research-021 C4 named 'Stewart v. Colonial Western Agency, Inc. (2001) 87 Cal.App.4th 1006' as the authority and the evidence packet labelled the record 'Published/certified for publication', but the stored CIT-REAL-6 excerpt was only the two substantive rules passages: it contained no caption, no court, no reporter citation, no filing date and no publication language. A reviewer had to supply the identity and the status from outside the packet. The substantive half of C4 -- what the deposition rules are -- was never in doubt and its two pinpoints (p4, p5) are untouched.

registry_edit_a_excerpt_extension.case: Stewart v. Colonial Western Agency, Inc. (2001) 87 Cal.App.4th 1006
registry_edit_a_excerpt_extension.change: The opinion's own opening identification passage was added in FRONT of the two round-1 runs ('Opinion CURRY, J.— Background This is an appeal from an order imposing sanctions in the amount of $2,400 on appellant Colonial Western Agency, Inc.'s counsel. The underlying matter involves a complaint by respondent Mary Martha Stewart against Colonial Western.'), and the opinion's Disposition and concurrence block was added at the END ('Disposition The January 18, 2000, order imposing sanctions on Colonial Western's counsel as corrected nunc pro tunc on September 20, 2000, is affirmed. Vogel (C. S.), P. J., and Hastings, J., concurred.'). Text was only ADDED and only at the ends: the two round-1 runs and the ' ... ' join between them are byte-identical, so p4 and p5 are still verbatim substrings.
registry_edit_a_excerpt_extension.text_source: Same CourtListener full text used in the round-1 re-excerpt (REST API v4, token-authenticated, cluster 5808646, xml_harvard; scratchpad b9brepair/cl_stewart_harvard.txt). Each of the four runs is located by an explicit start/end anchor pair, sliced out of the full text, asserted in code to be a whitespace-normalized substring of it, and asserted to be in document order. Nothing transcribed by hand.
registry_edit_a_excerpt_extension.what_the_source_cannot_supply: NO official-reporter caption block exists in this record. Cluster 5808646 stores only xml_harvard and html_with_citations, both of which begin at 'Opinion CURRY, J.—', and the cluster's headmatter field is the empty string (verified by direct API fetch on 2026-07-28, scratchpad b9br4/cluster_5808646.json). Unlike the html_lawbox records repaired in round 1 (Cembrook, Bridgestone, Lippel, Briggs, Equilon) there is therefore no verbatim run stating the caption, the court, the reporter citation or the filing date; those four facts are grounded by registry edit B instead.
registry_edit_a_excerpt_extension.aggregator_caveat: Unchanged. Stewart is a pre-archive Court of Appeal decision with NO official courts.ca.gov hosting (documented since B8a); the NO_OFFICIAL_HOSTING caveat stays disclosed and is still surfaced in the reviewer bundle.

registry_edit_b_new_index_record.locator: California Official Reports, volume 87 Cal.App.4th citation index (window covering page 1006)
registry_edit_b_new_index_record.target_entry: Stewart v. Colonial Western Agency, Inc. | Date Filed: March 14th, 2001 | Citations: 87 Cal. App. 4th 1006, 105 Cal. Rptr. 2d 115, 2001 Daily Journal DAR 2663, 2001 Cal. App. LEXIS 197, 2001 Cal. Daily Op. Serv. 2090 | Docket Number: No. B139311
registry_edit_b_new_index_record.method: Identical to the nine B7 index records and the five added in round 1: raw curl of the volume index (not LLM-mediated), every <article> block parsed for the case name and the page's own literal 'Date Filed:', 'Citations:' and 'Docket Number:' values, sorted by official-reporter starting page, the entries bracketing page 1006 transcribed verbatim and joined by ' ;; '.
registry_edit_b_new_index_record.role: Official-reporter citation metadata only. It supplies the caption, citation, filing date and docket number the opinion text lacks, and -- because an entry in the California Official Reports index is what publication in the Official Reports consists of -- the publication half of the status claim. No substantive legal proposition rests on it.
registry_edit_b_new_index_record.precedent: Exactly the route round 1 used for research-023 C3 and verification-real-002/003/007, and round 2 for verification-real-005 C1; every one of those was APPROVED by both vendors afterwards.

criterion.before: States, on the authority of Stewart v. Colonial Western Agency, Inc. (2001) 87 Cal.App.4th 1006, that objections to the relevancy, materiality, or admissibility at trial of deposition testimony are unnecessary and are not waived by failure to make them at the deposition, and that a deponent must not be prevented by counsel from answering a question unless it pertains to privileged matters or deposing counsel's conduct has reached a stage warranting suspension of the deposition to permit a motion for a protective order.
criterion.after: States, on the authority of Stewart v. Colonial Western Agency, Inc. — the appellate opinion published in the California Official Reports at 87 Cal.App.4th 1006, filed March 14, 2001 in docket No. B139311, and citable as a published California opinion — that objections to the competency of the deponent, or to the relevancy, materiality, or admissibility at trial of the testimony or of the materials produced, are unnecessary and are not waived by failure to make them before or during the deposition, and that a deponent must not be prevented by counsel from answering a question unless it pertains to privileged matters or deposing counsel's conduct has reached a stage where suspension of the deposition to permit a motion for a protective order is warranted.
criterion.legal_content: Equivalent on the substance. The bare parenthetical '(2001) 87 Cal.App.4th 1006', which rested on registry metadata alone, is replaced by the entailed 'published in the California Official Reports at 87 Cal.App.4th 1006, filed March 14, 2001 in docket No. B139311, and citable as a published California opinion', every clause of which is quoted underneath the criterion. The rule wording is also tightened to the court's own phrasing ('competency of the deponent', 'or of the materials produced', 'before or during the deposition').
criterion.deliberate_omission: The criterion does NOT say 'Court of Appeal'. No packet excerpt uses that phrase -- the index page carries no court label and the opinion text carries no caption -- so the criterion says 'appellate opinion published in the California Official Reports at 87 Cal.App.4th 1006', which p6 (appeal from an order, authoring justice), p7 (a presiding justice plus two associate justices) and p8 (the Official Reports volume index) do entail.
